sloka: सदृशा यो अत्र दर्पेण रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ।अत्र मन्युर् न कर्तव्यो रोषये त्वाम् न भीषये ॥६-३७-२३॥।।
transliteration: sadṛśā yo atra darpeṇa rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ ।atra manyur na kartavyo roṣaye tvām na bhīṣaye ॥6-37-23॥।।

translations.english: "Here, in this case do not be angry. I am telling out of my duty and not out of indignation or to cause anger or fear in you. You are capable of resisting even Devatas."
